sources.name: vLLM
sources.evidence: Llama-2-7b TP1 has K4096, gate/up hidden 11008 and down 11008x4096. The registered benchmark includes M1 and M16. Only these dimensions are reused; the Vulkan contract is entirely F32.

sources.name: ggml
sources.evidence: Non-cooperative strict F32 matrix/vector kernels and fused SiLU multiply; original shader sources, F32 storage and reduction, no implicit F16. Exact buffer ranges require a narrower aligned-load domain than a padded carrier.

shape_policy: Finite complete-chain architecture comparison, not a production trace, model throughput claim or inferred invocation frequency.
numerics: F32 weights, activations, reductions, SiLU and outputs. No Q4, F16, cooperative matrix or TF32 ranking.
storage: Identical contents in separate native contexts, immutable resident weights and two independent input/run/output slots per arm. Cold transpose and upload are reported separately; no dense shadow weight copy remains resident.
selection_policy: Qualify mature shader integration and fixed native rules at actual device/driver/compiler versions. No claim of an HYLE algorithm win or of beating the complete ggml runtime; unknown hardware remains unqualified.
